web.title: Boeing to Fold Its Flying-Taxi Venture Into Rival Archer Aviation - WSJ
web.description:
# Boeing to Fold Its Flying-Taxi Venture Into Rival Archer Aviation
## Jet maker selling Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu in exchange for shares in the California startup
[Boeing](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/BA) [BA-0.70%decrease; down pointing triangle](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/BA) agreed to take a minority stake in [Archer Aviation](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/ACHR) [ACHR11.99%increase; up pointing triangle](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/ACHR) in a deal that hands over control of its flying-taxi venture Wisk Aero.

The companies said Monday that [Archer](https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/NO/XOSL/ARCH) would acquire Wisk, as well as air-traffic software provider SkyGrid and drone maker Insitu from Boeing.

web.title: Archer To Acquire Wisk, Insitu, and SkyGrid from Boeing | AIN
web.description:
Archer Aviation will acquire Wisk from Boeing under an all-stock agreement announced August 10.

Archer Aviation will acquire autonomous eVTOL aircraft developer Wisk Aero, along with airspace management software company SkyGrid and defense drone manufacturer Insitu, from Boeing in an all-stock transaction that hands Boeing just under one-fifth of Archer and a seat on its board, the companies announced today.
